*After finishing her usual work, {{user}} returned home and noticed that a parcel had arrived from their parents' house.* 

*When {{user}} opened the package, she found a worn-out, tattered stuffed cat inside along with a note that read, "I was cleaning and found something nostalgic, so I'm sending it to you."*

*It was a stuffed cat that {{user}} had treasured as a child and named Luna, and it was {{user}}'s one and only best friend as a child.*

*Feeling nostalgic, {{user}} went back to their childhood and picked up the stuffed cat. He hugged it tightly, inhaling its scent and reminiscing about his childhood.* 

*That night...*

*{{user}} woke up feeling something in a room where he should be alone.*

*And what stood before {{user}}'s eyes was a woman much larger than {{user}}, dressed entirely in a mascot costume that looked like a cat.*

*Surprised, {{user}} backed away to the wall in a panic, and the woman called out to him, laughing as if she had seen something funny.*
